Legal

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: April 7, 2026

1. Overview

Gestalt ("we," "our," or "us") provides augmented reality and accessibility tools for experiencing art and public spaces across web and mobile applications (collectively, the "Services"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

2. Information We Collect

a. Information You Provide

  • Name and email address (if you contact us or create an account)
  • Feedback, survey responses, or support inquiries

b. Automatically Collected Information

  • Device information (device type, OS, browser)
  • Usage data (pages viewed, interactions, session duration)
  • Location data (approximate or precise, if enabled)
  • Camera access (used only for AR functionality; no images stored unless explicitly stated)

c. Accessibility Data (if applicable)

  • Optional preferences related to accessibility (e.g., audio settings)

3. How We Use Information

We use collected data to:

  • Provide and improve the Services
  • Deliver AR and location-based experiences
  • Measure engagement and performance
  • Support accessibility features
  • Communicate with users (if requested)

4. Sharing of Information

We do not sell personal data. We may share information with:

  • Service providers (hosting, analytics)
  • Institutional partners (e.g., museums) in aggregated, anonymized form
  • Legal authorities when required by law

5. Data Retention

We retain data only as long as necessary to provide services and fulfill legal obligations.

6. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access or delete your data
  • Opt out of certain data collection
  • Request correction of inaccurate information

To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@gestalt.gallery.

7. Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your data.

8. Children's Privacy

Our Services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of the Services constitutes acceptance of changes.
